why_seated: THE ALEXANDER SEAM. The esoteric/exoteric partition of the corpus is transmitted as a letter between Alexander and Aristotle (Alex. 7); the Iliad recension and Callisthenes stand beside it; Sulla 26 carries the Rome hinge. Seated whole so that every locus resolves to bytes.
